title: Convention of Moss
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Convention of Moss", at revision 1320728189, opens: "The Convention of Moss (Mossekonvensjonen) was a ceasefire agreement signed on 14 August 1814 between the King of Sweden and the Norwegian government. It followed the Swedish-Norwegian War due to Norway's claim to sovereignty. It also became the de facto peace agreement and formed the basis for the personal union between Sweden and Norway that was established when the Norwegian Stortinget (Parliament) elected Charles XIII of Sweden as king of Norway on 4 November 1814. The Union lasted until Norway declared its dissolution in 1905." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q33773, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1814 ceasefire agreement between Sweden and Norway". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
